intent: Metric 3: unit tests for int_world_output__yearly (IMF chain, missing IMF year, leap years, filters)

edits.new_content:
version: 2
models:
- name: int_world_output__yearly
  description: 'Metric 3: world real output (GDP, constant 2015 US$) in every year from GTA V''s launch
    year to GTA 6''s, and its even daily and per-second rates. One row per year.'
  config:
    meta:
      dex:
        grain:
        - data_year
        population:
          rule: Every year from var gta_v_year (2013) to var gta_6_year (2026), published or not; an unpublished,
            unestimated year keeps its row with NULL output.
        assumptions:
        - decision: What 'everything humanity made' measures
          chosen: World Bank world real GDP, NY.GDP.MKTP.KD, constant 2015 US$
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: Metric 3 plan, world output between GTA V and GTA 6; same price basis as Metric
            2''s per-capita series'
          column: annual_output
        - decision: Years covered
          chosen: 2013 to 2026, every year
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: bookended by the GTA V and GTA 6 releases (17 Sep 2013, 19 Nov 2026)'
          column: data_year
        - decision: Years the World Bank has not published
          chosen: last published GDP grown by IMF WEO world real GDP growth, no population adjustment,
            flagged is_estimate
          evidence: precedent
          detail: fct_world_productivity carries the unpublished year with the same IMF chain; total output
            takes no per-capita adjustment
          column: annual_output
        - decision: Daily output within a year
          chosen: spread evenly over the year's days (365 or 366)
          evidence: default
          detail: GDP is published yearly; no seasonality is claimed
          column: daily_output
  columns:
  - name: data_year
    description: Calendar year.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: key
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: annual_output
    description: World real GDP in the year, constant 2015 US$.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: 'NULL when unpublished and not estimated: unavailable, never zero.'
          aggregation: sum
          additivity: additive
          unit: currency:USD
  - name: is_estimate
    description: True when carried by IMF growth, not published by the World Bank.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: days_in_year
    description: 365, or 366 in a leap year.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
          unit: days
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: daily_output
    description: 'annual_output / days_in_year: the year spread evenly over its days.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: NULL when annual_output is.
          aggregation: sum
          additivity: additive
          unit: currency:USD
  - name: output_per_second
    description: 'daily_output / 86400: a rate, the yearly average spread evenly.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: NULL when annual_output is.
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: currency:USD
  - name: source_indicator
    description: World Bank indicator code.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
unit_tests:
